threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the tube like you’re at a bus stop, not realizing they come by every 2 minutes. The locals just glide in and out.
Caught a whiff of jerk chicken at 2 AM on the 59. Always a party at the bus stop, but the mix of spice and late-night chatter felt particularly alive last night.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a kid in the park asking his dad why the pigeons were always 'so funky'—that’s when I knew this place had its own vibe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find spontaneous street karaoke in the middle of a Kreuzberg market—one minute it's a hustle, the next, it turns into a concert.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they can tell you the difference between a ‘café con leche’ and a ‘latte’ just by looking at the foam.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tux on the 31 line, holding a bouquet. He looked nervous but the ride was smooth. Only in SF, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always think Gràcia is just for hipsters, but it’s the local bakery on Carrer de Fraternitat that keeps the neighborhood alive with scents of fresh pa amb tomàquet.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their confusion over the ‘tobacco’ shops—looking for cigars, but just finding paper and stamps.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the tube' instead of just 'the Overground' when you need to go to Shoreditch. Classic rookie mistake.
Saw a guy on the N181 holding a pizza box while trying to balance on one leg. When the bus hit a bump, he dropped it and everyone gasped.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I caught the smell of grilled halloumi at the Saturday market and saw neighbors arguing about the best kebab place—definitely felt like home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a cafe that serves 10 different types of vegan currywurst. It’s a quirky blend of tradition and modern veganism.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know the taco truck’s secret location changes every couple of months. Tourists just snap pics without tasting the real deal.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy in a tuxedo trying to catch the 49 while juggling a bouquet. Nailed the bus stop but dropped the flowers. Classic SF chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every tapas bar serves paella. It's like asking for pizza at a sushi place — they just don't do it here.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by how they still look for the menu in Spanish before realizing it's all in Catalan here.
